definitions.explanation: An emergency vehicle equipped to transport sick or injured people to a hospital and provide medical care during transport.

examples.japanese: {救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}を{呼|よ}んでください。
{救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}のサイレンが{聞|き}こえる。
examples.english: I can hear an ambulance siren.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}で{病院|びょういん}に{運|はこ}ばれた。
examples.english: My grandfather was taken to the hospital by ambulance.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}を{呼|よ}ぶ (to call an ambulance)
- {救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}で{運|はこ}ばれる (to be transported by ambulance)
- {救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}が{来|く}る (an ambulance arrives)

EMERGENCY NUMBER:
- In Japan, dial 119 for ambulance and fire emergencies.

RELATED TERMS:
- {救急|きゅうきゅう} (emergency, first aid)
- {救急隊員|きゅうきゅうたいいん} (paramedic)
